subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your recent flight booking from New York to London. Your flight is scheduled for June 15th, 2022, departing at 10:00 AM. Please arrive at the airport at least two hours before your flight. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
